Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 handling qualities, or DIPES 3 for rotary-wing air vehicles, for unassisted shipboard takeoff. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of shore-based and shipboard takeoff and departure to determine the control power, power and engine response, margin to control and flight envelope limits needed to maintain control and complete the launch and transition between phases of flight, including 2-D performance analysis and launch trajectories, and 6-DOF simulations for automatic control and trim settings for controls free launches, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, ship motion effects, ship speed and turn rate, headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum to maximum winds, including gusts and turbulence. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation of shore-based and shipboard takeoff and departure, and 6-DOF simulations for automatic control, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, ship motion effects, ship speed and turn rate, headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum to maximum winds, including gusts and turbulence. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct shore-based takeoff and departure for nominal and critical combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, and shore-based WOD equivalent magnitude and direction conditions from minimum to maximum winds.
  (3) Flight test: Conduct shipboard takeoffs for nominal and critical combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, including reversionary modes, and environmental conditions: launch method(s), ship departure patterns, multiple levels of ship motion, and headwind and crosswind conditions from minimum to maximum winds.
